o.text: Morphologically from kimya (“chemistry”) + -vi. The change of the second root vowel from a to ə occurred due to phonological adaptation to vowel harmony rules.
From Persian چشیدن (“to try, to taste”).
Calque of Persian دست شما درد نکنه (dast-e šomâ dard nakone, literally “may your hand not hurt”).
Derived from Middle Mongol 苦兒革 (kǔérgé /⁠kürge⁠/), whence Mongolian хүрэн (xüren, “brown”).
